Magical Beast (Hybrid) · 4 hexes · SM +2 Chimera (Enraged Eggplant; answers SRD 3.5, SRD 5.1)

A furred four-legged bulk with broad batlike wings and three heads set side by side at the shoulders, the last of them reptilian. That head breathes according to its colour — acid, lightning, fire or frost. Greedy, lazy and quarrelsome, it hoards whatever it kills within easy reach of where it sleeps.

  • GCS cost adjudication for "Per+5": the source states 50 points and the native GCS library computes 25. Adopted the native library value of 25. Increased Perception is 5 per level (B16), so Per+5 is 25. The stated 50 prices at 10 per level.
  • GCS cost adjudication for "Will+5": the source states 50 points and the native GCS library computes 25. Adopted the native library value of 25. Increased Will is 5 per level (B16), so Will+5 is 25. The stated 50 prices at 10 per level.
  • CER recomputed from the reviewed Typical Stats through the canonical Dungeons on Automatic CER path: OR 23, PR 32, CER 55, threat tier standard.
  • Conversion baseline reported OR 24, PR 32, CER 56 (tier standard). The reviewed values come from the consumer CER implementation, which rounds damage once after the damage-type multiplier and credits ranged accuracy; the conversion baseline ceilinged the damage base first and ignored range.
  • Encounter metadata derived (gregarious): average number appearing 2, wandering weight 3. Encounter metadata derived for 0.2.0 from the reviewed threat tier and creature class (appearing: minor 4 / standard 2 / major 1 / severe 1, forced to 1 for solitary classes — including swarms, which are a single multi-body creature — and raised to 6 for gregarious minor creatures; wandering weight: minor 4 / standard 3 / major 2 / severe 1). The fan-conversion source states no appearing-in-numbers or wandering values, so these are derived, not source mechanics.
  • Lair, treasure, and grappling remain unpopulated in 0.2.0 by package policy: the authorized fan-conversion source states no lair, treasure, or grappling values, and review declines to invent them. See review/policy/0.2.0-empty-field-policy.md.
  • Description text is original Dungeons on Automatic prose written from this record's own converted statistics and from the project's art direction for the creature. It is not derived from the authorized fan-conversion source, which states no creature descriptions, and not from any SRD. It carries its own authorship and CC BY 4.0 terms in the description field. See review/policy/description-policy.md.
